events.verdict: Beasley (DET) establishes a screening position in Daniels' (ATL) path and absorbs the contact.
Risacher (ATL) contests Cunningham's (DET) driving shot attempt and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Young (ATL) gathers the ball and legally takes two steps.
Thompson (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Young (ATL) at the end of the drive.
Harris (DET) maintains his pivot foot prior to his jump shot attempt.
Niang (ATL) firms up in a screening position in Thompson's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.
Cunningham (DET) and Risacher (ATL) both get their hands on the ball and the ensuing contact is incidental.
Harris (DET) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Niang (ATL) extends his forearm into Schroder's (DET) body and the contact during his driving shot attempt is more than marginal.
Schroder (DET) and Young (ATL) briefly engage and disengage during the screen.
Daniels (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball to block Beasley's (DET) shot attempt and any contact to the body prior to the blocked shot is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Stewart (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Stewart is in a legal guarding position alongside of Young's (ATL) path to the basket and Young creates the marginal arm contact.
Mann (ATL) commits a take foul on Schroder (DET).
Schroder (DET) reaches in and initiates contact to Young's (ATL) arm, which affects his SQBR.
Niang (ATL) commits a take foul on Thompson (DET).
Although Stewart (DET) steps into the lane prior to the release of the free throw, Young (ATL) does so as well and there is a violation by both players.
Stewart (DET) jumps forwards and initiates body contact with Young (ATL) that affects his jump shot attempt.
Young (ATL) commits a take foul on Beasley (DET).
